post.title: In which country are the SOUTHERN ALPS?
post.description:
The Alps that are nowhere near Europe. Switzerland, New Zealand or Chile? Guess first — then see the range drawn down the island.

Sources: NZ Department of Conservation, GNS Science, Britannica (Southern Alps), Wikipedia (Southern Alps, Aoraki / Mount Cook, South Island, Alpine Fault).
Map data: Natural Earth (public domain). Voice: AI (Kokoro).
